User Story: As an Admin, I want to view a list of all registered business entities so that I can manage corporate relationships and onboarding.

User Story: As a Relationship Manager, I want to filter businesses by their onboarding date to track monthly registration targets.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Provide "Start Date" and "End Date" calendar pickers at the top of the Business Management table. The "Search" button must refresh the list based on these dates.
Data Elements for Listing / Form: Search Query, Start Date (MM/DD/YYYY), End Date (MM/DD/YYYY).

User Story: As an Operations Officer, I want to upload multiple business profiles at once to save time during large merchant migrations.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Provide a "Bulk upload" button that accepts a standardized Excel/CSV template. The system must validate data for errors before finalizing the upload.
Data Elements for Listing / Form: File Upload (Excel/CSV).

User Story: As an Admin, I want to manually register a new business entity to initiate the account opening process.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Provide a "Create Business" button that opens a comprehensive registration form. (Details pending your next screenshot).

User Story: As an Admin, I want to capture comprehensive business data across four categories so that the corporate entity is fully profiled for KYC.

User Story: As an Auditor, I want to see who approved an identity and when to maintain accountability.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Table displays admin email and timestamp of approval.

User Story: As a KYC Checker, I want to export the NIN verification list for offline auditing and reporting.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view all customer accounts so that I can monitor account details and status.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System displays account number, account name, account type, tier level, and status. Admin can search, filter, view details, and export account data.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view detailed information about a customer account so that I can review profile information and account activity.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Admin selects an account to view profile details, tier level, account status, linked products, and transaction summary.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view all account entries so that I can track credits and debits affecting customer accounts.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System records every debit and credit entry linked to an account. Entries include transaction ID, entry type (debit/credit), amount, timestamp, product source, and status. Admin can search, filter, and export entries.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view the general ledger so that I can track all financial movements across the system.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System displays ledger records showing debit and credit balances across accounts. Admin can filter by date, product, or account type and export ledger reports.

User Story: As an admin, I want to manage the chart of accounts so that financial transactions are properly categorized.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System maintains structured accounts such as Assets, Liabilities, Revenue, Expenses, and Equity. Admin can create, edit, or deactivate ledger accounts.

User Story: As an admin initiator, I want to create a new ledger account so that new financial categories can be tracked in the system.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Admin enters account name, account code, account type (asset, liability, revenue, expense, equity) and submits for approval.

User Story: As an admin approver, I want to approve new ledger accounts so that only authorized accounts are added to the chart of accounts.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Admin approver reviews the request and can approve or reject. Once approved, the ledger account becomes active in the chart of accounts.

User Story: As an admin initiator, I want to freeze a customer account so that transactions can be temporarily restricted.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Admin selects account, enters freeze reason, and submits the request. Request goes to approval queue.

User Story: As an admin approver, I want to approve freeze requests so that restrictions are properly authorized.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Once approved, the account status changes to Frozen and transactions are blocked.

User Story: As an admin initiator, I want to unfreeze a frozen account so that the user can resume transactions.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Admin submits unfreeze request with remarks. Request goes to approval queue.

User Story: As an admin approver, I want to approve account unfreeze requests so that normal account operations can resume.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: Once approved, account status changes to Active and transactions are restored.
